verdict.rationale: Windmill's own docs and llms.txt describe it as an open-source, self-hostable workflow engine, and its source is published in a public GitHub repository (windmill-labs/windmill). That covers both reading the source and an open license at a general level. missing for 10: the specific license name and terms (e.g., any enterprise-feature carve-outs), independent confirmation of license details

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Windmill is an open-source and self-hostable workflow engine and developer platform
An open-source workflow engine and developer platform to build endpoints
Scripts are turned into sharable UIs automatically, and can be composed together into flows or used into richer apps built with low-code.
